reader_summary.overview: The International Consortium of Investigative Journalists is the organization responsible for the compilation and release of the first the Panama Papers. In this podcast, a16z general partner John O'Farrell interviews ICIJ director Gerard Ryle discuss how journalists manage. With so many moving parts, how does the ICIJ manage to keep high-stakes news stories under wraps until their slated day of release?
